places.quote: myrmidons of Justice, especially sent down from London
places.note: Hypothetical officers imagined by the narrator; London itself is the setting of the city.

places.quote: pitching into the studious youth of England
However, go to Miss Havisham’s I must, and go I did.
places.note: House named only by its owner here; Satis House is not named in this passage, and its location is fictional.

places.quote: might be engaged to fall upon me in the brewery
places.note: Unnamed brewery on Miss Havisham's property, referred to only hypothetically.
